ModMetaData.name: AASB II - VPE Skipdoor Pathing Redux Compat
ModMetaData.author: JG
ModMetaData.description: Compatibility patch for As above, So below II and VPE Skipdoor Pathing Redux. Adds a sparse hybrid routing graph where AASB stairs/elevators and VPE skipdoors can compete and combine across levels without pairwise skipdoor pathfinding.
